extension_rationale: MPF v0.2 §15 defines observed-l1.v0.2 as 'observed agent actions'. This profile extends the same conformance class to non-agent observation of external deterministic pipelines per §9.4.1, with actor.type=external_pipeline. It uses the baseline JCS canonicalization required by §2.9 and does not introduce any non-baseline canonicalization.

source_identity_required_fields: pipeline_identity (repo, commit, or stable identifier where available)
observation_profile_declarations.observer_code_identity_required: sha256 digest of observer module bytes
observation_profile_declarations.validator_code_identity_required: sha256 digest of validator module bytes
observation_profile_declarations.guard_key_rationale: observed_timestamp is supplied by the upstream artifact (current.asOf) which provides a stable upstream-pinned identifier per observation cycle.
observation_profile_declarations.retention_rationale: Per §9.4.1, higher-assurance observation profiles SHOULD retain bytes because public URLs are mutable. Digest+URL alone is insufficient for replay.
observation_profile_declarations.witness_independent_fetch_rationale: MVP is observed-l1-class. Witness independence at fetch time is a §20.5 (cross-boundary) concern; this profile does not claim cross-boundary conformance.

witness_requirements.operator_independence_rationale: MVP runs the L1 witness on the same node as the gateway/observer. This is acknowledged as the weaker assurance position per §11.5; the verifier profile reports it explicitly so relying parties can apply their own risk policy.

bundle_artifacts_excluded.policy-bundle.json: L2 policy is optional in §9.4.1 and excluded from MVP.
bundle_artifacts_excluded.operator-registry.json: Single-operator profile; operator identity is in admission-manifest.json instead.

verifier_must_recompute: every receipt's payload digest and resulting state root
every receipt signature against the keyring
registry payload digests and operator signatures
admission manifest payload digest and operator signature
validator's deterministic invariants over the fetched bytes
verifier_must_reject_on: any registry validity-window failure at observed_at time
any claim of policy-gated execution, capability-token enforcement, or upstream-process control
any actor.type outside the admitted set
any non-baseline canonicalization claiming mpf-0.2 conformance
